spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership and Seller entitlement are checked by the backend. Feature-disabled workspaces return feature_disabled and have no readable discovery section.
The returned revisionToken is opaque and source-bound. Preserve it exactly for a preview; a stale response requires a fresh read and preview.
A sampled observed ask does not prove continuous exposure or demand. Null prices, inventory, sale facts, timing and restoration facts remain unknown.

Admission provenance separates trusted seller orders and copies, covered TCG SKU transactions and units, current listing ask, sampled no-sale days, and qualified shared accepted support. Missing, stale, mismatched, or partial evidence remains unknown; the record makes no probability or causal uplift claim.

TCG market transactions may be a ManaPool proxy and are not buyer order IDs. Shared accepted support uses exact printing, finish, channel, current ask and live depth, pools conditions, and omits donor identity, date and price.
Manual admission remains labeled manual. Member provenance explains a saved choice; it is not a ranked recommendation list.
The summary reports first-sale printings, copies, order lines and orders separately. Estimated finding time is not measured packing time.
A settings-only restore reports settings state and does not reverse marketplace sends already admitted. Follow pages and retain limitations and missingFields.

description: Read a bounded below-floor discovery summary or one section page with member stages, scheduled minimums, canonical pricing targets, observed asks and source freshness, admission-selection facts, sales facts, and restoration status. Call it to inspect a seller workspace's configured discovery lane or follow a returned cursor. Member admissionSelection explains the factual automatic or manual choice already saved; this tool does not return a ranked recommendation queue. Observed asks are sampled listings, not continuous exposure or evidence of demand; scheduled minimum, canonical target, observed ask, and sold item price are separate facts. Use spellbook_below_floor_discovery_set with dryRun true to preview a requested change, then read this tool again after an apply.

channel.description: Restrict the read to one marketplace channel. Only combinations supported by the selected game are accepted.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same section and workspace. Pass it unchanged to continue.

game.description: Restrict the read to one game. Only combinations supported by the seller lane are accepted.

limit.description: Maximum rows returned on this page, within the bounded API page size.

section.description: The bounded response section. Start with summary; use a named section to inspect members and pass its nextCursor to continue.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace whose discovery facts to read. Required.

name: spellbook_below_floor_discovery_get
